description: Split a multi-tenant shared PostgreSQL database into per-tenant dedicated databases. Currently 200 tenants share 3 PostgreSQL instances. Migration must: enumerate tenants, provision per-tenant DBs, migrate data with row-level filtering, set up connection routing layer, dual-write to both shared and per-tenant DBs, verify row counts per tenant, then cutover application connections tenant-by-tenant. Must handle tenant-specific schema variations, maintain referential integrity, and provide per-tenant rollback. Risk factors: cross-tenant foreign keys, connection pool exhaustion during dual-write, partial tenant migration leaving inconsistent state. Tools available: pg_dump, pgloader, HAProxy, PgBouncer, CI/CD, feature-flags.
